# How to get help with InvoiceUI

This is a private invoicing workspace, not a public support desk.

1. Read [README.md](../README.md) for setup, scripts and architecture.
2. Read [CURSOR_PROGRESS.md](../CURSOR_PROGRESS.md) for what is already implemented.
3. Open a GitHub issue with the bug or feature template. Use synthetic data only.
4. Security problems: follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Do not file a public issue.
